detail_seo_description: Custom printed PVC banners for trade projects, with made-to-order dimensions, hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets.

detail.lead: Made-to-order printed PVC banners for shopfront signs, outdoor advertising, events and promotions. Produced to your finished dimensions from your artwork, in 550 gsm flex banner or black-back blockout flex, with finishing matched to the way the banner will be installed.
highlights: 550 gsm flex banner fabric — hangs flat and handles wind well
Black-back blockout option — opaque black reverse, for double-sided graphics and anti-show-through use
Custom dimensions based on your project brief
Hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets available
Cut to the requested finished size
applications: Fencing, site and temporary campaign displays
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished banners and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Rolled packing; banners are trimmed to the finished size before rolling
detail.artwork: Print-ready artwork can be supplied by the buyer. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive artwork changes or original design work are quoted separately.
detail.brief: Please share finished width and height, quantity, artwork, finishing positions (including eyelet spacing if specified), delivery format and destination.
detail.caveat: Material and construction are confirmed against the application: short-term event use and long-term outdoor exposure call for different choices, so share the installation position and display period and we will recommend accordingly. Finished dimensions, material and pricing are confirmed per order; no list prices are published.
